summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal developments and retail market updates, including notable court rulings and inflation forecasts impacting the sector.

bullets.text: CJP Protests: Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka released from detention by executive magistrate.
Kerala High Court confers Senior Advocate designation on 100-year-old P Balasubramanian Menon.
India's retail inflation may rise to 5.47% in September from 4.82% in August, driven by food prices, says UBI report.
Nat Habit raises Rs 142 crore in Series C funding to expand its manufacturing capacity and distribution network.
Ambani's Jio Platforms targets $106 billion valuation in upcoming IPO, sources say.
